descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-02 step 3; TFA-92580 AC 4 · “Scanned and manually added patients both default to Follow-up”.

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S03 Manual '+' add works in Hospital and Nursing Home and starts at Follow-up

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Manual '+' entry (Add New Patient page) works on its own and produces a patient that behaves exactly like a scanned one. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 3; TFA-92580 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Signed-in physician; the add form opened in Hospital and in Nursing Home

When Read the Encounter Type before touching it; fill /rounding/add (name, age, room, diagnosis) and submit; fill /snf/add (name) and submit

Then Encounter Type starts at Follow-up in both contexts and the status chosen is saved. Each patient appears on its own context's list

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in rounding.spec.ts, forms.spec.ts and encounter-type.spec.ts (getByLabel('Encounter Type') toHaveValue('follow-up') in each context). These cover 'manual entry works' and the manual Follow-up default only. Whether a manual patient behaves exactly like a scanned one is S05; the scanned side of U6 is S01/S02/S11/S12

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S03

Manual '+' add works in Hospital and Nursing Home and starts at Follow-up

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

  • encounter-type.spec.ts [chromium] — Nursing Home: the add form starts at Follow-up and saves the status chosen, the header sets all three, and the status pre-selects the note format — expected
  • forms.spec.ts [chromium] — accepts a resident and puts them on the roster — expected
  • rounding.spec.ts [chromium] — a patient added through the form appears on the list — expected
